description: Building Resilience in the Face of Ocean Acidification is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Alutiiq Pride Shellfish Hatchery; NOAA Pacific Marine Environmental Laboratory; U.S. Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA). The Alutiiq Pride Shellfish Hatchery in Seward, Alaska, is collaborating with federal and academic partners to measure the impacts of ocean acidification on shellfish and develop possible adaptation strategies. Coverage: Alaska (2017). The toolkit gives Alaska as the location, 2017 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
